title: Phase 6.2.39 — Full-Universe Evidence Routing & Readiness Accounting Report

governance.safety_invariant: AUTO_CANDIDATE is strictly a routing classification, NOT AUTO_APPROVED and NOT ACTIVE.

AUTO_CANDIDATE.definition: Satisfies all evidence gates programmatically (confident semantic, verified IPA, attested example, exact CEFR). Staged for promotion validation.

REVIEW_REQUIRED.definition: Strong lexical/semantic candidates with narrow margin, polysemy, or example review needed. Queue for human linguist verification.

HOLD.definition: Blocked by missing evidence (attested examples, semantic corroborated senses, Thai translations, or CEFR conflicts). Fail-closed quarantine.

baseline_delta_reconciliation.explanation: Phase 6.2.36 AUTO_READY accepted monosemous dictionary entries without independent semantic synonym corroboration against definition words. Phase 6.2.39 enforces the calibrated S1 >= 0.65, margin >= 0.15 gate alongside attested examples, verified IPA, and exact CEFR alignment.

test_results.sentence: She wrote a comprehensive article on science.
They bought a luxurious Persian carpet.
Please be careful when handling hot liquids.
This is a classic example of baroque architecture.
The daylight illuminated the mountain peak.
Sudden panic spread through the market.
We must warn travelers about the storm.
His father worked as an architect.
The religious dogma was questioned by scholars.
She started an international logistics business.

ai_draft_quarantine.rule: AI_DRAFT_ONLY items carry is_synthetic: true and source_grounded: false. They are strictly disqualified from satisfying attested example gates.

bottleneck_hierarchy.description: Over 44% of universe units lack attested real-world example sentences in current indexed corpora.
Single-candidate dictionary entries lacking rich English synonym overlaps in definition keywords.
Multiple competing Thai translations with narrow score margins requiring human editorial selection.
Headwords absent from LEXiTRON/Wiktionary (predominantly derivational adverbs ending in -ly).
OEWN synset mappings absent for target POS/sense key.
Divergence between Oxford CEFR and Cambridge/EVP level annotations.

phase_6240_recommendation.rationale: Data shows EXAMPLE_NOT_FOUND (44.54%) and SEMANTIC_NO_EVIDENCE (26.19%) account for over 70% of all primary blockers. Expanding attested sentence corpora (Tatoeba / OpenEdu) and enriching lexical synonym cross-references will unlock vastly more units than further polysemy algorithm tuning.
prohibited_actions: Do not run another polysemy POC (diminishing returns on 12% polysemy blocker)
Do not promote AUTO_CANDIDATE to ACTIVE without human staging review
Do not activate synthetic AI drafts to bypass example gates
